title: Best Scooter (2026)
summary: The guide lists five electric scooters that stand out for their performance, range, and portability.
method: Selected scooters from consumer reviews on CNET, Tom’s Guide, TechGearLab, and eRideHero. Chosen for the most detailed performance data and repeated mention across sites.
assumptions: Prices are not listed in the sources, so cost comparisons are omitted.

products.name: Segway Ninebot MAX G3
why: The Segway Ninebot MAX G3 is highlighted as the best scooter tested by TechGearLab, with a 500‑mile battery life and 12 months of riding experience. It offers a 30+ mile range and plush suspension. The review notes its performance and affordability compared to the G3 Max.
products.desc: The Segway Ninebot MAX G3 is an electric scooter that can travel 500 miles on a single charge and has a 30+ mile range. It features plush suspension and a folding design for portability.
products.benefit: Picture a commuter who needs a long‑range, comfortable ride for city streets. The Segway Ninebot MAX G3 offers a 500‑mile battery life and plush suspension, making it the most reliable choice for daily travel. It outperforms other picks in range, being the only scooter in this guide with a 500‑mile battery. The catch: it is heavier than some competitors.
cons: No mention of advanced safety features
products.skip_if: You need a lightweight scooter for short trips

products.name: Apollo Go
why: CNET lists the Apollo Go as the best electric scooter overall for 2026, noting its convenience for commuters and students.
products.desc: The Apollo Go is an electric scooter that is recommended as the best overall for 2026. It is suitable for commuters and students, offering a simple and efficient way to travel between points.
products.benefit: Picture a student running to class who needs a quick, reliable scooter. The Apollo Go is praised by CNET as the best overall scooter, making it a solid choice for short trips. It outperforms other picks in terms of overall recommendation but does not match the Segway MAX G3’s battery range. The catch: the review does not detail its battery life or suspension.
products.skip_if: You need long‑range or high‑performance features

products.name: VMAX VX2 Hub
why: CNET highlights the VMAX VX2 Hub as the best single‑motor scooter that hits like a dual, noting its performance and design.
products.desc: The VMAX VX2 Hub is an electric scooter that is praised for its single‑motor performance, delivering a ride that feels like a dual‑motor scooter. It is highlighted by CNET for its strong performance.
products.benefit: Picture a rider who wants a powerful single‑motor scooter that feels robust. The VMAX VX2 Hub delivers strong performance and a ride that feels like a dual‑motor scooter, making it a good choice for those who want power without the complexity of dual motors. It competes well in performance but does not offer the long battery range of the Segway MAX G3. The catch: the review does not mention its battery capacity or suspension.
products.skip_if: You need long battery life or advanced suspension
